sentences.text: Edith Marsh (S2) stated her son Gary lives with her, works at the garage on Station Road, and helps her with shopping, getting up, and administering tablets.
Edith Marsh (S2) stated she uses a walking frame and does not go upstairs.
Edith Marsh (S2) stated she uses a commode and is not always quick enough to reach the toilet in time, wearing pads.
Edith Marsh (S2) stated that when the pad is wet, Gary changes her if he is home, or she manages herself.
Edith Marsh (S2) stated she is alone all day while Gary is at work, from approximately 7:00 PM until he returns (sometimes as late as 9:00 PM).
Edith Marsh (S2) stated that Gary usually leaves her a sandwich for lunch.
Pauline Reid (S3) disclosed that there is no food in the fridge, noting that on a Saturday she found only a bit of gone-off milk, and that she brought Edith Marsh (S2) a dinner. It
Pauline Reid (S3) stated that the fridge has been empty three or four times in the last few weeks.
Pauline Reid (S3) disclosed that Edith Marsh (S2) has not had her tablets for a week, as the box is full since last Tuesday.
Pauline Reid (S3) stated the box is on the side.
Edith Marsh (S2) stated she forgets her tablets.
Edith Marsh (S2) stated she has been living at the address since 1962 and does not want to move.
Edith Marsh (S2) stated she would accept carers coming in if Gary does not mind, as she does not want him upset.
Pauline Reid (S3) disclosed that she visits most afternoons and observed that Edith Marsh (S2) is left in wet clothes for four or five days a week, with the pad and skirt wet when
Pauline Reid (S3) stated that when she visited at 2:00 PM, the pad and skirt were wet.
Pauline Reid (S3) stated she helps change Edith Marsh (S2) if she allows it.
Edith Marsh (S2) stated that sometimes she does not like to make a fuss for Gary.
Edith Marsh (S2) stated that Gary has never hit her or hurt her, though she noted he is just tired.
Pauline Reid (S3) stated she has never seen anything like hitting or hurting, and that Gary is not unkind to her, just not there.
Janet Fielding (S1) stated she is raising a safeguarding concern regarding Edith Marsh (S2) being left wet, without food, and without tablets.
Edith Marsh (S2) agreed to the safeguarding concern being raised if it helps Gary.
Edith Marsh (S2) stated she receives her pension paid into her own account and has her card.
Edith Marsh (S2) stated she does not receive Attendance Allowance.
Pauline Reid (S3) confirmed that she asked Gary once if Edith Marsh (S2) receives Attendance Allowance.
Pauline Reid (S3) stated she is willing to continue popping in.
Pauline Reid (S3) provided her phone number as 0146.
Janet Fielding (S1) stated she would ring Dr Patel (GP) about the missed tablets and ask the chemist about a blister pack and a check.
Janet Fielding (S1) stated she would arrange an emergency home care package with two calls a day (morning and lunchtime) for washing, changing, and a meal, starting by Friday the 2
Janet Fielding (S1) stated she would phone Gary tonight to book his carer's assessment for next week.
Janet Fielding (S1) stated she would return on Wednesday the 2nd of December with the Attendance Allowance form.
